## Verdict: PASS

Every failing line of the brief is CONFIRMED: Q139 and x-02:28 fixed and pinned, x-02:27 pinned (no source change, as
asked), Q39's runner half fixed and pinned with the fabric half REPORTED to M0-b-03 S9 (another item's file, RL3). Every
pin is re-killed by the seat's own mutant (17 / 18 killed; the one survivor, D6, is a deliberate-writer escape on the
new optional member, note 32). The refusal census did not rise (0 → 0). Every gate exits 0, NEAR 92 / 92 and
RELATED@1000 259 files / 3316 tests green. No blocker was found.

(The lane ran in two seats: the first ran every probe, mutant and gate, wrote this file as a draft and handed the
RELATED@1000 run to a background chain (J714); a fresh seat of the same lane, on the same machine, read the chain's
`related.log` / `related.rc` (never re-run), re-read `report.ts:271 – 276`, `runner.ts:240 – 245`, `:348 – 388` and
`registry.ts:85 – 91` against §1's claims, confirmed `runner.ts`, `report.ts`, `registry.ts` and `bentCutFabric.ts`
`cmp`-equal between the tree and mirror `m1` after the chain, and closed the verdict.)

## 2. Census and mirror proof (CONFIRMED, executed)

The seat's probe (`probe/probe.test.ts`, mirror-only): `runBase` over `FLAT_BLUEPRINT` and `RIVER_BLUEPRINT` (CITY,
`areaHa` 900, `walledHa` 30), seeds 1 – 6, each without and with a block floor injected (`env.floors: block →
{ minAreaCm2: 1 }`) — 24 runs per mirror; per run the root, stage roots, order, ranks, `model.refusals`, `bugs`, the whole
report (`canonicalText`), the L1 face-rank histogram, S8's committed batches seen by the base's `onBatch` and by
`RunOptions.observe`.

* **Census (J264, N-58), `m0` (before) vs `m1` (after):** 24 / 24 runs byte-equal in every field; refusals **0 → 0**,
  `bugs []` on every run. Not risen. The one new refusal (an `E_` code offered as a warning) is a throw on an UNLAWFUL
  call (stage code passing a refusal as a warning), class REFUSE with a verbatim text; no §11.4 door reaches it (only
  stage code holds a sink); no caller offers one.
* **Mirror proof, `m2` (own patch) vs `m1` (tree):** model roots, stage roots, order, stage ranks, refusals and bugs
  IDENTICAL on 24 / 24 runs (NO-SHIFT; e.g. flat-1 `1735393580,1869980807,885767725,3342250577`, river-2
  `3121952418,1019466348,1574284503,2734185373`). The report differs only in S8's entry: `block-floor`'s count and
  `work['cut.kernelCalls']`. With the floor injected the block-floor count equals the district batches committed (the
  tree's `onBatch` count): flat 1 – 6 = 10, 11, 11, 11, 10, 10; river 1 – 6 = 12, 16, 11, 11, 11, 13; without a floor it
  reads 0 (x-02:28). The tree reads 0 in both modes. `cut.kernelCalls` through the door: 11203, 10832, 10982, 11023,
  11070, 10943, 11369, 12712, 12433, 10888, 10798, 9036 (the tree 0). These equal the builder's table figure for figure.
* Note 30 CONFIRMED: S8's L1 faces carry rank 4 on the tree and 5 through the door (flat-1 L1 `{0:1, 1:1, 3:14, 4:185}`
